items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Possession, use and enjoyment, exclusion, disposition, and control, subject to PETE
items.answerZh: 佔有、使用收益、排除、處分、控制（受 PETE 限制）
items.trapEn: Ownership is not immune from government police power.
items.trapZh: 沒有絕對豁免政府警察權
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Bundle of rights」，應立刻聯想：佔有、使用收益、排除、處分、控制（受 PETE 限制）。易錯提醒：沒有絕對豁免政府警察權。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Police power, eminent domain, taxation, and escheat
items.trapEn: These are the four government powers over real property.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「PETE」，應立刻聯想：Police／Eminent Domain／Taxation／Escheat。補充說明：四大公權力。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Demand, utility, scarcity, and transferability
items.trapEn: Indestructibility is not an element of value.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「DUST（價值四要素）」，應立刻聯想：Demand＋Utility＋Scarcity＋Transferability。易錯提醒：不是 indestructibility。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Impaired transferability
items.trapEn: The missing element is not utility.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Cloud on title」，應立刻聯想：缺 Transferability（可轉讓性）。易錯提醒：不是缺 utility。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: The three physical characteristics of land
items.trapEn: Malleability is not a physical characteristic of land.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Immobility」，應立刻聯想：土地三大物理特性。易錯提醒：malleability 不是。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Economic preference for location
items.answerZh: 地利／理想區位偏好 → Location
items.trapEn: Do not confuse situs with illiquidity or inflation.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Situs」，應立刻聯想：地利／理想區位偏好 → Location。易錯提醒：不是 illiquidity、通膨。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: The act or process of combining adjacent parcels
items.answerZh: 合併相鄰地塊的「行為／過程」
items.trapEn: Plottage is the resulting increase in value.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Assemblage」，應立刻聯想：合併相鄰地塊的「行為／過程」。補充說明：Plottage 才是合併後增值。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: The added value created when combined parcels are worth more together
items.answerZh: 合併後整體價值 > 分開加總
items.trapEn: The combining process itself is assemblage.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Plottage」，應立刻聯想：合併後整體價值 > 分開加總。補充說明：過程叫 assemblage。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Added property, natural or artificial, becomes part of the real property
items.answerZh: 自然或人為附加物歸土地所有人
items.trapEn: Accession includes processes such as accretion.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Accession」，應立刻聯想：自然或人為附加物歸土地所有人。補充說明：含 accretion 等。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Gradual addition of land by deposited soil
items.trapEn: Reliction is land exposed by receding water.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Accretion」，應立刻聯想：淤積使土地增加。補充說明：Reliction＝水面退卻露出新陸。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Erosion is gradual loss; avulsion is sudden removal by water
items.answerZh: 侵蝕漸失／突發沖刷喪失
items.trapEn: Avulsion generally does not immediately change the boundary.
items.trapZh: Avulsion 通常不立刻改地界
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Erosion」，應立刻聯想：侵蝕漸失／突發沖刷喪失。補充說明：Avulsion 通常不立刻改地界。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: A higher-value property is pulled down by lower-value neighboring properties
items.answerZh: 高價屋被低價鄰房「往下拉」
items.trapEn: Progression is the opposite effect.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Principle of regression」，應立刻聯想：高價屋被低價鄰房「往下拉」。對照記憶：Progression 相反。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: A lower-value property is enhanced by higher-value neighboring properties
items.answerZh: 低價屋被高價鄰房「往上帶」
items.trapEn: Regression is the opposite effect.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Principle of progression」，應立刻聯想：低價屋被高價鄰房「往上帶」。對照記憶：Regression 相反。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: The most probable price under typical market conditions
items.answerZh: 典型條件下理論最可能成交價
items.trapEn: Market price is the actual amount paid.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Market value」，應立刻聯想：典型條件下理論最可能成交價。補充說明：Market price＝實際成交價。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Value set by the county assessor for property taxation
items.trapEn: California Proposition 13 limits increases in assessed value.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Assessed value」，應立刻聯想：課稅用評估價（County Assessor）。補充說明：Prop 13 限制加州漲幅。

items.sectionZh: 權利束、土地特性與價值（DUST）
items.sectionEn: Bundle of Rights, Land Traits & Value (DUST)
items.answerEn: Value impaired by psychological or social stigma rather than a physical defect
items.answerZh: 心理／社會污名壓價（非物理瑕疵）
items.trapEn: A notorious event is not structural damage.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Stigmatized property」，應立刻聯想：心理／社會污名壓價（非物理瑕疵）。易錯提醒：兇案傳聞≠結構損壞。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Land, fixtures, and appurtenant rights
items.trapEn: Standing timber remains real property until severed.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Real property」，應立刻聯想：土地＋定著物＋附屬權利。補充說明：未砍立木仍是不動產。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Movable property and unattached materials
items.trapEn: Loose paving stones not installed are personal property.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Personal property」，應立刻聯想：可移動物、未固定建材。補充說明：鬆散鋪石未鋪＝動產。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Changing real property into personal property by detaching it
items.answerZh: 不動產分離成動產（砍樹）
items.trapEn: Cutting a tree is severance, not annexation.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Severance」，應立刻聯想：不動產分離成動產（砍樹）。易錯提醒：不是 annexation。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Attaching personal property so it becomes a fixture
items.trapEn: Use the MARIA fixture test.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Annexation」，應立刻聯想：動產附著成定著物。補充說明：MARIA 測試。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Method, adaptability, relationship, intention, and agreement
items.trapEn: When the agreement is silent, intention is often the key factor.
items.trapZh: 契約沉默時 Intention 最關鍵
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「MARIA」，應立刻聯想：Method／Adaptability／Relationship／Intention／Agreement。補充說明：契約沉默時 Intention 最關鍵。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: A business tenant's removable equipment, treated as personal property
items.answerZh: 商業租客營業設備＝動產，租期前可拆
items.trapEn: Remove it before the lease ends and repair any damage.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Trade fixture」，應立刻聯想：商業租客營業設備＝動產，租期前可拆。補充說明：須修復損害。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: A right or improvement that runs with and transfers with the land
items.answerZh: 附隨土地移轉（地役權、建物、礦權等）
items.trapEn: It commonly transfers even if not separately stated in the deed.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Appurtenance」，應立刻聯想：附隨土地移轉（地役權、建物、礦權等）。補充說明：契據未寫也常隨移轉。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: Annual crops produced by a tenant's labor
items.answerZh: 耕作農作物收益（勞動收益）
items.trapEn: Naturally growing plants are fructus naturales.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Emblements」，應立刻聯想：耕作農作物收益（勞動收益）。補充說明：天然樹木＝fructus naturales。

items.sectionZh: 不動產、動產、定著物與 MARIA
items.sectionEn: Real vs Personal Property, Fixtures & MARIA
items.answerEn: A physical intrusion across a property line and continuing trespass
items.trapEn: An encroachment is not an easement.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Encroachment」，應立刻聯想：實體越界＝持續 trespass。易錯提醒：不是 easement。

items.answerEn: The greatest ownership estate, inheritable and devisable by will
items.answerZh: 最高完整所有權，可立遺囑繼承
items.trapEn: A life estate ends at the measuring life and cannot be devised beyond it.
items.trapZh: Life estate 不能 will 給子女
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Fee simple absolute」，應立刻聯想：最高完整所有權，可立遺囑繼承。易錯提醒：Life estate 不能 will 給子女。

items.answerEn: Title automatically reverts when the stated limitation is violated
items.trapEn: Look for durational words such as “so long as” or “until.”
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Fee simple determinable」，應立刻聯想：違條件→產權「自動」歸還。補充說明：so long as／until。

items.cueEn: Fee simple subject to condition subsequent
items.cueZh: Fee simple subject to condition subsequent
items.answerEn: Grantor must exercise a right of re-entry to recover title after breach
items.answerZh: 違條件→須「上法院」取回（Right of re-entry）
items.trapEn: Title does not revert automatically.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Fee simple subject to condition subsequent」，應立刻聯想：違條件→須「上法院」取回（Right of re-entry）。易錯提醒：不會自動歸還。

items.answerEn: An estate limited to the life of a named person
items.answerZh: 以權利人壽命為限，死亡終止
items.trapEn: It terminates at death and cannot be devised to children.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Life estate」，應立刻聯想：以權利人壽命為限，死亡終止。易錯提醒：不可立遺囑傳子女。

items.answerEn: A life estate measured by the life of another person
items.answerZh: 以「第三人」壽命衡量的終身產權
items.trapEn: The phrase means “for the life of another.”
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Pur autre vie」，應立刻聯想：以「第三人」壽命衡量的終身產權。補充說明：for the life of another。

items.answerEn: A leasehold with definite beginning and ending dates
items.answerZh: 固定起迄日，到期自動結束
items.trapEn: It expires automatically without termination notice.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Estate for years」，應立刻聯想：固定起迄日，到期自動結束。易錯提醒：不必通知終止。

items.cueEn: Periodic estate / estate from period to period
items.answerEn: A tenancy that renews automatically until proper notice is given
items.answerZh: 按月／按週自動續約，須通知才停
items.trapEn: Month-to-month is the common example.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Periodic estate」，應立刻聯想：按月／按週自動續約，須通知才停。補充說明：Month-to-month。

items.answerEn: A tenancy that either party may terminate at will
items.answerZh: 雙方可隨時終止的隨意租賃
items.trapEn: It has no fixed ending date.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Estate at will」，應立刻聯想：雙方可隨時終止的隨意租賃。補充說明：較少書面固定期。

items.answerEn: A holdover tenant remains after the lawful tenancy expires
items.trapEn: The landlord has not agreed to a new tenancy.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Estate」，應立刻聯想：租期滿仍佔用（holdover）。補充說明：房東尚未同意或驅離。

items.answerEn: Estate for years, periodic estate, estate at will, and estate at sufferance
items.trapEn: A freehold estate is not a leasehold.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Leasehold 四類型」，應立刻聯想：Years／Period／Will／Sufferance。易錯提醒：Freehold 不是租賃。

items.answerEn: A personal, usually revocable privilege to use another's land
items.answerZh: 個人特權、通常可撤銷、不跑隨土地
items.trapEn: A license does not run with the land; oral parking permission is a common example.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「License（許可）」，應立刻聯想：個人特權、通常可撤銷、不跑隨土地。補充說明：口頭停車常是 license。

items.answerEn: An easement that runs with the land and benefits a dominant tenement
items.answerZh: 附屬地役權，跑隨土地，通常須書面
items.trapEn: It involves both a dominant and a servient tenement.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Appurtenant easement」，應立刻聯想：附屬地役權，跑隨土地，通常須書面。補充說明：需役地＋供役地。

items.answerEn: An easement benefiting a person or company rather than a dominant parcel
items.answerZh: 個人／公司地役權（如公用事業）
items.trapEn: Utility easements are common examples.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Easement in gross」，應立刻聯想：個人／公司地役權（如公用事業）。補充說明：通常不附屬某需役地。

items.answerEn: An easement acquired through open, notorious, hostile, and continuous use for the statutory period
items.answerZh: 公開、敵意、持續使用達法定年限
items.trapEn: It resembles adverse possession but creates use rights, not title.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Easement by prescription」，應立刻聯想：公開、敵意、持續使用達法定年限。補充說明：類似時效。

items.answerEn: Access implied when a parcel would otherwise be landlocked
items.trapEn: It commonly arises when one parcel is divided.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Easement by necessity」，應立刻聯想：土地封鎖時通行必要。補充說明：常因分割產生。

items.answerEn: The dominant tenement benefits; the servient tenement bears the easement
items.trapEn: The servient land carries the burden.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Dominant」，應立刻聯想：需役地／供役地。補充說明：供役地負擔通行。

items.answerEn: A lien securing payment for labor or materials improving real property
items.answerZh: 施工未付款之技工留置權
items.trapEn: It clouds title until paid or otherwise released.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Mechanic's lien」，應立刻聯想：施工未付款之技工留置權。補充說明：限制處分直到清償。

items.answerEn: An owner-created burden such as a deed of trust or mortgage
items.trapEn: It reduces unencumbered equity.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Voluntary encumbrance」，應立刻聯想：如 deed of trust／mortgage。補充說明：減損未負擔淨值。

items.answerEn: A private restriction on how land may be used
items.answerZh: 私人限制「如何使用」土地
items.trapEn: It is imposed privately, often by a developer.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Deed restriction」，應立刻聯想：私人限制「如何使用」土地。補充說明：發起者是私人／開發商。

items.cueEn: Conflict between zoning and a deed restriction
items.answerEn: Comply with the more restrictive requirement
items.trapEn: Do not automatically choose public law or the least restrictive rule.
items.trapZh: 不是永遠公法勝／最寬鬆
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Zoning vs deed restriction」，應立刻聯想：兩者衝突→遵「最嚴格」。易錯提醒：不是永遠公法勝／最寬鬆。

items.answerEn: Illegal, void, and unenforceable under fair housing law
items.trapEn: The invalid restriction generally does not invalidate the deed.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「種族」，應立刻聯想：無法執行＋違法（Fair Housing）。補充說明：地契本身通常仍有效。

items.answerEn: The restriction is void, but title and the deed remain valid
items.answerZh: 條款無效，不影響所有權／deed
items.trapEn: The property does not automatically revert.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Deed restriction 違法時」，應立刻聯想：條款無效，不影響所有權／deed。易錯提醒：不會自動 revert。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Creates an agency relationship between the seller-client and listing broker
items.trapEn: A written agreement is the best practice.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Listing agreement」，應立刻聯想：Customer→Client，成立 listing agent。補充說明：最佳用書面。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Full commission regardless of who sells, including an owner-sale
items.answerZh: 誰賣出都付全額佣金（含屋主自售）
items.trapEn: This listing gives the broker the greatest protection.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Exclusive right-to-sell」，應立刻聯想：誰賣出都付全額佣金（含屋主自售）。補充說明：最保障經紀人。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: One broker is appointed, but the owner may sell without owing a commission
items.answerZh: 只找一家，但屋主自售可免佣
items.trapEn: Do not confuse it with exclusive right-to-sell.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Exclusive agency」，應立刻聯想：只找一家，但屋主自售可免佣。補充說明：Audrey／Janelle 題型。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Multiple brokers may compete; only the procuring cause earns the commission
items.answerZh: 多家競爭，須證明 Procuring cause
items.trapEn: An owner-sale usually produces no commission.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Open listing」，應立刻聯想：多家競爭，須證明 Procuring cause。補充說明：自售常免佣。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Seller states a required net amount; broker may keep the excess as compensation
items.answerZh: 賣方定淨得，超額歸經紀人
items.trapEn: Legal in California but risky and requiring full disclosure.
items.trapZh: 加州合法但高風險須充分揭露
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Net listing」，應立刻聯想：賣方定淨得，超額歸經紀人。補充說明：加州合法但高風險須充分揭露。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: The uninterrupted chain of events that produces a ready, willing, and able buyer
items.answerZh: 不中斷促成鏈→拿佣金依據
items.trapEn: It is especially important in an open listing.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Procuring cause」，應立刻聯想：不中斷促成鏈→拿佣金依據。補充說明：Open listing 關鍵。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Commission protection for a later sale to a prospect introduced during the listing
items.answerZh: 到期後一定期間內賣給曾帶看買家仍付佣
items.trapEn: It prevents avoiding commission by waiting for expiration.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Protection」，應立刻聯想：到期後一定期間內賣給曾帶看買家仍付佣。補充說明：防過河拆橋。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Destruction of the property terminates the listing
items.trapEn: Fire or similar destruction is the usual fact pattern.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Extinction of subject matter」，應立刻聯想：房屋毀損→listing 終止。補充說明：龍捲風／火災。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Completion of the transaction and the agency purpose
items.trapEn: Performance is preferable to revocation or expiration.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Performance（終止代理）」，應立刻聯想：最理想：成交履約完成。補充說明：優於 revocation／expiration。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: One broker represents both buyer and seller in the same transaction
items.trapEn: Requires disclosure and informed consent.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Dual agency」，應立刻聯想：同時代理買賣雙方。補充說明：須同意與揭露。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Loyalty, lawful obedience, reasonable care, accounting, and disclosure
items.answerZh: 忠誠、服從（合法）、注意、會計、揭露等
items.trapEn: An agent must not obey an illegal instruction.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Fiduciary duties」，應立刻聯想：忠誠、服從（合法）、注意、會計、揭露等。補充說明：不服從違法指示。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: A principal's conduct causes a third party reasonably to believe an agency exists
items.answerZh: 言行讓第三人誤信有代理＋未澄清
items.trapEn: The principal may be estopped from later denying the agency.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Ostensible agency」，應立刻聯想：言行讓第三人誤信有代理＋未澄清。補充說明：事後不得否認。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.cueEn: Buyer Representation and Broker Compensation Agreement (BRBC)
items.answerEn: The C.A.R. form is nonexclusive by default
items.trapEn: It does not become nonexclusive only when a special box is checked.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「BRBC（C.A.R.）」，應立刻聯想：預設非專屬買方代理。易錯提醒：不必勾選才變非專屬。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.cueZh: NAR 會員佣金糾紛仲裁
items.answerEn: Arbitration is generally required when one party properly requests it
items.answerZh: 一方要求→通常強制仲裁
items.trapEn: Waiver generally requires written agreement of all parties.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「NAR 會員佣金糾紛仲裁」，應立刻聯想：一方要求→通常強制仲裁。補充說明：須全體書面才可放棄。

items.sectionZh: 代理關係與 Listing 類型
items.answerEn: Agency law and contract law
items.trapEn: Agency principles generally control an agency-specific conflict.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Agency 受何法管轄」，應立刻聯想：Agency law ＋ Contract law。補充說明：衝突時代理法常優先。

items.answerEn: A promise exchanged for another promise
items.answerZh: 雙方互為承諾（買賣約典型）
items.trapEn: A purchase agreement is the standard example.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Bilateral contract」，應立刻聯想：雙方互為承諾（買賣約典型）。補充說明：promise for promise。

items.answerEn: A promise exchanged for performance
items.trapEn: A reward is paid only when the requested act is completed.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Unilateral contract」，應立刻聯想：承諾換行為（懸賞）。補充說明：找到才付錢。

items.answerEn: A contract inferred from conduct
items.trapEn: It is not an express written or oral agreement.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Implied contract」，應立刻聯想：由行為成立（攔計程車）。易錯提醒：非 express／written。

items.answerEn: An agreement stated in words, either orally or in writing
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Express contract」，應立刻聯想：口頭或書面明確約定。

items.answerEn: A signed contract with obligations still unperformed
items.answerZh: 已簽但尚未完全履約（簽約到 closing）
items.trapEn: Executed means all obligations have been completed.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Executory」，應立刻聯想：已簽但尚未完全履約（簽約到 closing）。補充說明：Executed＝已全部完成。

items.answerEn: A contract in which both parties have fully performed
items.trapEn: A closed transaction is the usual example.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Executed contract」，應立刻聯想：雙方義務已全部履行。補充說明：交屋過戶後。

items.answerEn: No legal effect from its inception
items.trapEn: Voidable means a protected party may elect to rescind.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Void」，應立刻聯想：自始無效。補充說明：Voidable＝可選擇撤銷。

items.cueEn: When an offer becomes a binding contract
items.answerEn: The offeree accepts and communicates acceptance to the offeror
items.answerZh: Offeree 接受＋通知送達 Offeror
items.trapEn: Signing without communicating acceptance is insufficient.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Offer 何時變合約」，應立刻聯想：Offeree 接受＋通知送達 Offeror。補充說明：僅簽名未送達不夠。

items.answerEn: The offeror may revoke before acceptance is communicated
items.answerZh: 接受通知送達前可 rescind
items.trapEn: After effective acceptance, it is no longer merely an offer to revoke.
items.trapZh: 接受後不能當要約撤回
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「撤回要約期限」，應立刻聯想：接受通知送達前可 rescind。易錯提醒：接受後不能當要約撤回。

items.answerEn: Rejection of the original offer and creation of a new offer
items.answerZh: 拒絕原要約＋提出新要約
items.trapEn: The original offer is terminated.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Counteroffer」，應立刻聯想：拒絕原要約＋提出新要約。補充說明：原要約死亡。

items.cueEn: Outstanding counteroffer and a new offer
items.answerEn: Withdraw the prior counteroffer before accepting the new offer
items.answerZh: 先撤回舊 counter 再回新 offer
items.trapEn: This avoids obligations to two buyers.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「多份報價時已發 counter」，應立刻聯想：先撤回舊 counter 再回新 offer。補充說明：防一屋賣兩人。

items.answerEn: A good-faith deposit showing serious intent
items.trapEn: It is not required consideration for contract formation.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Earnest money」，應立刻聯想：善意誠意金／定金。易錯提醒：非契約成立必要對價。

items.answerEn: Legally sufficient consideration exchanged for a promise
items.trapEn: An empty or illusory promise may be insufficient.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Valuable consideration」，應立刻聯想：足夠且適當的對價。補充說明：空頭白話可能不足。

items.answerEn: Court order requiring transfer of the particular real property
items.trapEn: Real property is considered unique.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Specific performance」，應立刻聯想：強制交付特定不動產。補充說明：因土地唯一性。

items.answerEn: An agreed amount the seller may retain after a buyer's unjustified breach
items.trapEn: Often tied to the earnest money deposit.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Liquidated damages」，應立刻聯想：常＝賣方可扣留誠意金。補充說明：買方無故違約。

items.answerEn: Cancellation restoring the parties to their precontract positions
items.trapEn: It is not an order compelling closing.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Rescission」，應立刻聯想：解除契約、回復原狀。易錯提醒：不是強迫交屋。

items.answerEn: Contract duties generally pass to the estate unless personal services are involved
items.answerZh: 通常遺產承受；個人服務契約例外
items.trapEn: A listing is commonly treated as a personal-services agreement.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「死亡對契約」，應立刻聯想：通常遺產承受；個人服務契約例外。補充說明：Listing 常屬個人服務。

items.answerEn: Most contracts involving real property must be in writing
items.answerZh: 多數不動產合約須書面
items.trapEn: A lease for one year or less may be enforceable orally.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Statute of Frauds」，應立刻聯想：多數不動產合約須書面。補充說明：≤1 年租約口頭可有效。

items.answerEn: May be enforceable without a writing
items.trapEn: An eighteen-month lease must be in writing.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「9-month lease」，應立刻聯想：可不書面。補充說明：18-month 須書面。

items.answerEn: Valid for real estate contracts when the parties consent
items.answerZh: 當事人同意即可用於 RE 合約
items.trapEn: E-SIGN and UETA support electronic transactions.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「電子簽名」，應立刻聯想：當事人同意即可用於 RE 合約。補充說明：E-SIGN／UETA。

items.answerEn: Unreasonable prejudicial delay can bar equitable relief
items.answerZh: 拖延過久致對方受損→衡平救濟被拒
items.trapEn: Relief may be denied even before the statute of limitations expires.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Doctrine of laches」，應立刻聯想：拖延過久致對方受損→衡平救濟被拒。補充說明：即使訴訟時效未過。

items.answerEn: Generally bars prior or contemporaneous oral terms that contradict an integrated writing
items.answerZh: 原則限制用口頭改完整書面合約
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Parol evidence rule」，應立刻聯想：原則限制用口頭改完整書面合約。

items.answerEn: Allows cancellation or renegotiation based on unsatisfactory inspections
items.answerZh: 檢查不合格可解約／談判
items.trapEn: A leaking roof is a typical fact pattern.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Inspection contingency」，應立刻聯想：檢查不合格可解約／談判。補充說明：屋頂漏水題。

items.answerEn: Protects the buyer if the property appraises below the contract price
items.trapEn: It may weaken an offer in a strong seller's market.
items.trapZh: 賣方市場加此條款較不具競爭力
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Appraisal contingency」，應立刻聯想：估價不足可走。補充說明：賣方市場加此條款較不具競爭力。

items.answerEn: Allows the buyer to cancel if specified financing cannot be obtained
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Finance contingency」，應立刻聯想：貸款不成可走。

items.answerEn: A condition protecting a party's right to withdraw before satisfaction or removal
items.answerZh: 條件成就前可保護一方退出
items.trapEn: An addendum is not itself a cancellation right.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Contingency 本質」，應立刻聯想：條件成就前可保護一方退出。易錯提醒：Addendum≠退出權本身。

items.answerEn: A fact that could affect a buyer's decision or price and therefore must be disclosed
items.answerZh: 會改變買賣決策／出價的事實→必須揭露
items.trapEn: An “as-is” clause does not excuse disclosure.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Material fact」，應立刻聯想：會改變買賣決策／出價的事實→必須揭露。易錯提醒：As-is 不能免。

items.answerEn: Seller declines repairs but must still disclose known material defects and complete required disclosures
items.answerZh: 不願修繕，但仍須填 TDS、揭露已知重大瑕疵
items.trapEn: As-is does not mean no disclosure.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「As-is（加州）」，應立刻聯想：不願修繕，但仍須填 TDS、揭露已知重大瑕疵。補充說明：常見迷思。

items.answerEn: Seller disclosure of known condition for one-to-four residential units
items.answerZh: 1–4 住宅賣方已知屋況揭露
items.trapEn: School-district information is not part of the TDS.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「TDS」，應立刻聯想：1–4 住宅賣方已知屋況揭露。補充說明：不含學區資訊。

items.cueEn: Late personal delivery of the TDS
items.answerEn: Buyer generally has three days after personal delivery to cancel
items.answerZh: 買方通常 3 天可取消
items.trapEn: Delivery by mail or electronic transmission generally allows five days.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「TDS 親送晚交」，應立刻聯想：買方通常 3 天可取消。補充說明：郵寄／電子常 5 天。

items.answerEn: Commonly exempt from the seller's TDS requirement
items.trapEn: A lender-owner often lacks personal knowledge of condition.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Foreclosure」，應立刻聯想：常豁免填 TDS。補充說明：銀行不知屋況。

items.answerEn: Discloses mapped flood, fire, earthquake, and other natural hazard zones
items.answerZh: 揭露是否在洪患／火災／地震等災害區
items.trapEn: It is not the form specifically for asbestos or lead.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「NHD」，應立刻聯想：揭露是否在洪患／火災／地震等災害區。易錯提醒：不是石棉／鉛的專用表。

items.answerEn: Federal disclosure applies to most pre-1978 residential property
items.trapEn: A home built in 1964 is within the rule.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Lead-based paint」，應立刻聯想：Pre-1978 強制聯邦揭露。補充說明：1964 建＝要揭露鉛。

items.answerEn: A hidden defect not discoverable by ordinary inspection
items.answerZh: 常規看屋難發現的隱性瑕疵
items.trapEn: Asbestos behind drywall is a typical example.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Latent defect」，應立刻聯想：常規看屋難發現的隱性瑕疵。補充說明：乾壁後石棉。

items.answerEn: A defect that is open and readily observable
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Patent defect」，應立刻聯想：明顯可見瑕疵。

items.answerEn: Do not disclose protected medical-status information
items.answerZh: 禁止揭露（公平住房／隱私）
items.trapEn: Nondisclosure here complies with privacy and fair housing rules.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「HIV/AIDS 前住戶」，應立刻聯想：禁止揭露（公平住房／隱私）。補充說明：遵從不揭露＝合法。

items.answerEn: A death within the prior three years may require disclosure; an older natural death generally does not
items.answerZh: 通常近 3 年內須考量；6 年前自然死亡常不必
items.trapEn: Apply the California Civil Code rule and answer direct questions truthfully as required.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「死亡揭露（加州）」，應立刻聯想：通常近 3 年內須考量；6 年前自然死亡常不必。補充說明：Civil Code 相關。

items.answerEn: Provide the standard statutory notice; a broker generally need not investigate independently
items.answerZh: 合約標準提示即可；經紀人不必主動調查披露
items.trapEn: Do not treat it exactly like a physical defect of the property.
items.trapZh: 不是物業物理重大事實同等義務
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Megan's Law」，應立刻聯想：合約標準提示即可；經紀人不必主動調查披露。易錯提醒：不是物業物理重大事實同等義務。

items.cueEn: Seller instructs agent to conceal a defect
items.answerEn: Refuse the illegal instruction, disclose as required, and consider terminating the agency
items.answerZh: 拒絕＋仍須向買方揭露／可終止委託
items.trapEn: Obedience does not extend to unlawful concealment.
items.trapZh: 服從不法指示會共同負責
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「賣方要求隱瞞瑕疵」，應立刻聯想：拒絕＋仍須向買方揭露／可終止委託。補充說明：服從不法指示會共同負責。

items.cueEn: Paint used to hide a foundation crack
items.answerEn: Disclose the concealed material defect or risk misrepresentation liability
items.trapEn: Do not advise the seller merely to improve the concealment.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「油漆掩蓋地基裂縫」，應立刻聯想：必須揭露，否則 misrepresentation。易錯提醒：不是叫他漆更好。

items.answerEn: A widely used industry form, not a single state-promulgated mandatory contract
items.answerZh: 常用住宅買賣約，但州政府未強制頒布唯一表
items.trapEn: California does not prescribe it as the only statewide form.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「RPA（C.A.R.）」，應立刻聯想：常用住宅買賣約，但州政府未強制頒布唯一表。易錯提醒：非 promulgated statewide。

items.answerEn: Buyer and seller
items.trapEn: The broker is ordinarily an agent, not a party to the sale contract.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「買賣約當事人」，應立刻聯想：Buyer ＋ Seller。易錯提醒：Broker 不是合約當事人。

items.answerEn: Unconscious stereotypes that cause unequal service
items.answerZh: 無意識刻板印象差別服務
items.trapEn: A person may sincerely claim fairness while acting on hidden assumptions.
items.trapZh: 自認公平卻假設有色人種買便宜房
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Implicit bias」，應立刻聯想：無意識刻板印象差別服務。補充說明：自認公平卻假設有色人種買便宜房。

items.answerEn: Conscious, intentional discrimination
items.answerZh: 明知故犯歧視（拒服務同性伴侶）
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Explicit bias」，應立刻聯想：明知故犯歧視（拒服務同性伴侶）。

items.answerEn: Directing people toward or away from neighborhoods based on a protected characteristic
items.trapEn: Steering violates fair housing law.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Steering」，應立刻聯想：依族群導向特定社區。補充說明：違法。

items.answerEn: Inducing sales through fear that a protected group is entering the area
items.trapEn: Blockbusting is illegal.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Blockbusting」，應立刻聯想：恐嚇社區變動促拋售。補充說明：違法。

items.answerEn: Denying or restricting credit based on neighborhood or protected-group patterns
items.trapEn: Redlining is illegal.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Redlining」，應立刻聯想：依地區／族群拒貸。補充說明：違法。

items.answerEn: Ethics are external professional standards; morals are personal convictions
items.answerZh: Ethics＝外部團體標準化；Morals＝個體內心
items.trapEn: The NAR Code of Ethics is an external standard.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Ethics vs Morals」，應立刻聯想：Ethics＝外部團體標準化；Morals＝個體內心。補充說明：NAR Code of Ethics。

items.cueEn: Lack of competence in a specialized area
items.answerEn: Disclose the lack of expertise before providing the service
items.trapEn: NAR Article 11 addresses competence.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「缺專業領域能力」，應立刻聯想：提供服務「之前」須揭露。補充說明：NAR Article 11。

items.answerEn: Mixing client trust funds with a broker's personal or business funds
items.answerZh: 個人資金與客戶信託金混合
items.trapEn: Conversion is actually taking or spending the client's money.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Commingling」，應立刻聯想：個人資金與客戶信託金混合。補充說明：Conversion＝挪用花掉。

items.cueEn: Appraisal fee based on appraised value
items.answerEn: Unethical and inconsistent with appraisal independence and USPAP
items.trapEn: Compensation cannot depend on reaching a particular value.
items.trapZh: 費不能掛鉤估出來的價值
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Appraisal fee 依估值加減」，應立刻聯想：不道德／違反 USPAP。易錯提醒：費不能掛鉤估出來的價值。

items.answerEn: State agency that regulates real estate licenses
items.trapEn: C.A.R. and NAR are trade associations, not licensing enforcement agencies.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「DRE」，應立刻聯想：加州執照監管機關。易錯提醒：C.A.R.／NAR 是協會非執法。

items.answerEn: Head of the California Department of Real Estate
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Real Estate Commissioner」，應立刻聯想：DRE 首長。

items.answerEn: Keep required transaction records for at least three years
items.trapEn: Count from closing or the relevant statutory event.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「交易文件保存」，應立刻聯想：結案起至少 3 年。補充說明：2022/6/20 → 2025/6/20。

items.answerEn: A formal valuation performed by a properly licensed or certified appraiser
items.answerZh: 僅持牌估價師可做正式估價
items.trapEn: The appraisal must comply with USPAP.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Appraisal」，應立刻聯想：僅持牌估價師可做正式估價。補充說明：須符合 USPAP。

items.answerEn: A broker's informal pricing analysis; no appraiser license is required
items.trapEn: A CMA is not a formal appraisal.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「CMA」，應立刻聯想：不需估價師執照。易錯提醒：非正式意見。

items.answerEn: A broker's opinion of property value or probable selling price
items.answerZh: 經紀人價格意見，低於正式 appraisal
items.trapEn: It is less formal than an appraisal.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「BPO」，應立刻聯想：經紀人價格意見，低於正式 appraisal。

items.answerEn: Usually the best approach for existing owner-occupied homes
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Sales comparison」，應立刻聯想：中古屋最常用。

items.answerEn: Best suited to new construction and special-purpose properties
items.trapEn: Land value plus replacement or reproduction cost minus depreciation.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Cost approach」，應立刻聯想：新成屋／特殊建築首選。補充說明：土地＋重建成本－折舊。

items.answerEn: Used for income-producing property
items.trapEn: Apply the IRV relationship.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Income approach」，應立刻聯想：收益性物業。補充說明：IRV。

items.answerEn: Use nearby, similar sales, preferably from the last six to twelve months
items.answerZh: 同社區＋近 6–12 月＋至少約 3 筆
items.trapEn: A comparable twenty-five miles away is usually too distant.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「CMA 選 comp」，應立刻聯想：同社區＋近 6–12 月＋至少約 3 筆。補充說明：25 英里太遠。

items.answerEn: Adjust the comparable, never the subject property
items.trapEn: If the comparable lacks a bathroom, add its value to the comparable's price.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「調整方向」，應立刻聯想：永遠調 Comp，不調 Subject。補充說明：Comp 少衛浴→加價。

items.answerEn: Building specialized market knowledge and prospects in a defined geographic area
items.answerZh: 深耕特定地理區域成專家
items.trapEn: It does not mean agriculture or indiscriminate citywide marketing.
items.trapZh: 不是真的務農；也非全市撒網
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Farm area」，應立刻聯想：深耕特定地理區域成專家。易錯提醒：不是真的務農；也非全市撒網。

items.answerEn: The seller's initial asking price
items.trapEn: It is not necessarily the final sale price.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Listing price」，應立刻聯想：初始要價 Asking price。易錯提醒：≠最終成交價。

items.answerEn: Income at 100% occupancy before vacancy or collection loss
items.trapEn: No vacancy allowance has yet been deducted.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「PGI」，應立刻聯想：100% 滿租理想總收入。補充說明：未扣空置。

items.answerEn: PGI minus vacancy and collection loss plus other income
items.answerZh: PGI－空置／呆帳＋其他收入（未扣營業費用）
items.trapEn: Operating expenses have not yet been deducted.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「EGI」，應立刻聯想：PGI－空置／呆帳＋其他收入（未扣營業費用）。

items.answerEn: EGI minus operating expenses
items.trapEn: NOI normally excludes debt service and income taxes.
items.trapZh: 通常不含貸款本息與所得稅
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「NOI」，應立刻聯想：EGI－營業費用＝營運淨利。補充說明：通常不含貸款本息與所得稅。

items.answerEn: NOI divided by value
items.trapEn: IRV states Income = Rate × Value.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Cap rate」，應立刻聯想：NOI ÷ Value。補充說明：IRV：I＝R×V。

items.answerEn: NOI divided by the capitalization rate
items.trapEn: Annualize monthly NOI before dividing.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Value（收益法）」，應立刻聯想：NOI ÷ Cap rate。補充說明：先年化月 NOI×12。

items.cueEn: Monthly NOI of $10,000 at a 6% cap rate
items.answerEn: Annual NOI is $120,000; value is $2,000,000
items.trapEn: Do not divide monthly NOI directly by the annual cap rate.
items.trapZh: 別直接用月 NOI 去除
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「月 NOI $10,000、cap 6%」，應立刻聯想：年 NOI $120,000 → Value $2,000,000。補充說明：別直接用月 NOI 去除。

items.answerEn: Capitalization rate is 5%
items.trapEn: Do not choose 10% or 20%.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「NOI $25,000」，應立刻聯想：Cap＝5%。易錯提醒：不是 10%／20%。

items.cueZh: 投資人要扣日常費用後利潤
items.answerEn: Use Net Operating Income (NOI)
items.trapEn: PGI and EGI are measured before operating expenses.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「投資人要扣日常費用後利潤」，應立刻聯想：看 NOI。易錯提醒：不是 PGI／EGI。

items.cueEn: Income after vacancy but before operating expenses
items.cueZh: 只要收入扣空置、不問費用
items.answerEn: Use Effective Gross Income (EGI)
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「只要收入扣空置、不問費用」，應立刻聯想：看 EGI。

items.answerEn: Generally indicates higher risk and a lower value relative to income
items.answerZh: 通常風險較高／價值相對較低
items.trapEn: A lower cap rate generally indicates the reverse.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Cap rate 高」，應立刻聯想：通常風險較高／價值相對較低。補充說明：反之亦然。

items.answerEn: Borrower who conveys bare legal title under a deed of trust
items.trapEn: The -or is the party giving or creating the interest.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Trustor」，應立刻聯想：借款人（設定信託）。補充說明：-OR 給出權利。

items.cueEn: Trustee under a deed of trust
items.answerEn: Neutral third party holding bare legal title for the security instrument
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Trustee」，應立刻聯想：受託人持名義產權。

items.cueEn: Beneficiary under a deed of trust
items.answerEn: Lender whose loan is secured by the deed of trust
items.trapEn: The beneficiary receives the benefit of the security.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Beneficiary」，應立刻聯想：貸款機構。補充說明：-EE 收受。

items.answerEn: Borrower who gives the mortgage
items.trapEn: The mortgagee is the lender.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Mortgagor」，應立刻聯想：借款人／抵押人。補充說明：Mortgagee＝銀行。

items.answerEn: Party granting the option, usually the seller
items.answerZh: 給出選擇權的一方（通常賣方）
items.trapEn: The optionee is the prospective buyer.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Optionor」，應立刻聯想：給出選擇權的一方（通常賣方）。補充說明：Optionee＝買方。

items.answerEn: Grantor transfers title; grantee receives title
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Grantor」，應立刻聯想：讓與人／受讓人。

items.answerEn: Loan amount divided by property value
items.trapEn: A high LTV conventional loan may require PMI.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「LTV」，應立刻聯想：貸款額÷價值。補充說明：高 LTV 常需 PMI。

items.answerEn: Insurance protecting a conventional lender on a high-LTV loan
items.answerZh: 傳統貸款高 LTV 的抵押保險
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「PMI」，應立刻聯想：傳統貸款高 LTV 的抵押保險。

items.answerEn: Housing payment-to-income ratio and total debt-to-income ratio
items.trapEn: LTV is not a borrower qualifying ratio.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Qualifying ratios」，應立刻聯想：Payment-to-income ＋ Debt-to-income。易錯提醒：不是 LTV。

items.answerEn: Principal multiplied by annual interest rate, divided by twelve
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Interest-only 月息」，應立刻聯想：本金×利率÷12。補充說明：$140k×4.9%÷12＝$571.67。

items.cueEn: Monthly interest on an amortized loan
items.answerEn: Calculated on the remaining principal balance
items.trapEn: Early payments contain a larger interest portion.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Amortized loan 月利息」，應立刻聯想：依「剩餘本金」計息。補充說明：前期利息多。

items.answerEn: Interest rates, points, and loan costs tend to rise
items.trapEn: Credit does not become cheaper.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「緊縮貨幣市場」，應立刻聯想：利率↑、點數／開辦費↑。易錯提醒：不是更便宜。

items.cueEn: Increase in the supply of loan funds
items.answerEn: Interest rates tend to fall
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「資金供給增加」，應立刻聯想：利率↓。

items.answerEn: The former owner may deduct rent as a business operating expense
items.answerZh: 租金可當營業費用抵稅
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Sale-leaseback 優勢」，應立刻聯想：租金可當營業費用抵稅。

items.answerEn: Paying or receiving a kickback for settlement-service referrals
items.trapEn: Example: a title company pays for referrals.
items.trapZh: 如 title 公司付錢轉介
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「RESPA 違規」，應立刻聯想：因轉介付回扣／kickback。補充說明：如 title 公司付錢轉介。

items.answerEn: Requires disclosure of the true cost and terms of consumer credit
items.trapEn: TILA does not set market interest rates.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「TILA」，應立刻聯想：揭露真實借貸成本。補充說明：不決定利率升降。

items.answerEn: Carries implied covenants that title was not previously conveyed and has no undisclosed grantor-created encumbrances
items.answerZh: 含兩項默示保證（未移轉給他人、未設定未揭露負擔）
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Grant deed（加州常用）」，應立刻聯想：含兩項默示保證（未移轉給他人、未設定未揭露負擔）。

items.answerEn: Conveys whatever present interest the grantor may have, with no title warranties
items.answerZh: 轉讓「現有任何權利」，幾乎無保證
items.trapEn: Often used to clear a cloud or release a possible claim.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Quitclaim deed」，應立刻聯想：轉讓「現有任何權利」，幾乎無保證。補充說明：清雲／放棄權利常用。

items.answerEn: Provides broad title warranties and covenants
items.trapEn: Its use and covenant details vary by state.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Warranty deed」，應立刻聯想：保證最多（六大契約）。補充說明：視州而異。

items.answerEn: Implies the grantor holds transferable title but provides few warranties
items.answerZh: 暗示持有可轉讓權，保證少
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Bargain and sale」，應立刻聯想：暗示持有可轉讓權，保證少。

items.answerEn: The “to have and to hold” clause defining the estate granted
items.answerZh: “to have and to hold” 定義權利範圍
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Habendum clause」，應立刻聯想：“to have and to hold” 定義權利範圍。

items.answerEn: Operative words showing the grantor's intent to transfer title
items.answerZh: 表明移轉意圖的核心句
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Granting clause」，應立刻聯想：表明移轉意圖的核心句。

items.cueEn: Delivery and acceptance of a deed
items.answerEn: Both are required for the deed to become effective
items.answerZh: 契據生效必要：交付＋接受
items.trapEn: The grantor's signature alone is insufficient.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Delivery and acceptance」，應立刻聯想：契據生效必要：交付＋接受。補充說明：只簽名不夠。

items.answerEn: Gives constructive notice to the world
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Recording」，應立刻聯想：產生 Constructive notice。

items.answerEn: Direct, personal knowledge of a fact
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Actual notice」，應立刻聯想：親身／直接知悉。

items.answerEn: Knowledge imputed by law because the public record could be examined
items.answerZh: 推定應查公共紀錄而知
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Constructive notice」，應立刻聯想：推定應查公共紀錄而知。

items.answerEn: A summarized history of recorded instruments affecting title
items.answerZh: 產權檢索後的歷史摘要報告
items.trapEn: It is a report, not a title plant.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Abstract of title」，應立刻聯想：產權檢索後的歷史摘要報告。易錯提醒：不是 title plant。

items.answerEn: A title company's organized database of land and title records
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Title plant」，應立刻聯想：產權公司資料庫設施。

items.answerEn: Title reasonably free from significant defects and encumbrances
items.answerZh: 無重大負擔／瑕疵、可安心轉售
items.trapEn: It is title a prudent buyer can accept and later resell.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Marketable title」，應立刻聯想：無重大負擔／瑕疵、可安心轉售。補充說明：清 significant encumbrances。

items.answerEn: The successive history of ownership transfers
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Chain of title」，應立刻聯想：產權移轉連鎖。

items.answerEn: A description sufficient to identify one specific parcel
items.answerZh: 足以唯一區辨的法定描述
items.trapEn: A street address is not a legal description.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Legal description」，應立刻聯想：足以唯一區辨的法定描述。易錯提醒：≠街道地址。

items.answerEn: Withholds a right or excludes an existing interest from the grant
items.answerZh: 契據保留權利或載明既有 easement
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Reservation」，應立刻聯想：契據保留權利或載明既有 easement。

items.answerEn: Court-supervised administration of a decedent's estate
items.trapEn: Testate means with a will; intestate means without one.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Probate」，應立刻聯想：遺產認證／法庭程序。補充說明：Testate＝有遺囑；Intestate＝無。

items.answerEn: Acquisition of title through open, notorious, hostile, continuous possession meeting statutory requirements
items.answerZh: 公開敵意佔用達年限可取得所有權
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Adverse possession」，應立刻聯想：公開敵意佔用達年限可取得所有權。

items.answerEn: Dedication transfers private land to public use; a public grant transfers public land to a private party
items.answerZh: 私人捐地給政府／公地撥給私人
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Dedication」，應立刻聯想：私人捐地給政府／公地撥給私人。

items.answerEn: Begins at a point of beginning and follows bearings and distances back to the POB
items.answerZh: 從 POB 沿方位距離繞回；度分秒
items.trapEn: Often references monuments or benchmarks and degrees, minutes, and seconds.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Metes and bounds」，應立刻聯想：從 POB 沿方位距離繞回；度分秒。補充說明：有 landmark／benchmark。

items.answerEn: Uses principal meridians, baselines, townships, ranges, and sections
items.trapEn: A notation such as T2S R2W identifies the grid location.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Government」，應立刻聯想：Township、Range、Section、Meridian。補充說明：T2S R2W。

items.answerEn: Identifies a parcel by lot, block, and recorded subdivision map
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Lot and block」，應立刻聯想：分區圖地號。

items.answerEn: 43,560 square feet
items.trapEn: Two acres equal 87,120 square feet.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「1 acre」，應立刻聯想：43,560 sq ft。補充說明：2 acres＝87,120。

items.answerEn: Usually 640 acres
items.trapEn: A standard section is one mile by one mile.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Section」，應立刻聯想：通常 640 acres。補充說明：1 mile×1 mile。

items.answerEn: Assignee takes the tenant's entire remaining leasehold and commonly pays rent directly to the landlord
items.answerZh: 受讓人常直接付租金給房東
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Assignment」，應立刻聯想：受讓人常直接付租金給房東。

items.answerEn: Subtenant pays rent to the original tenant, who retains a reversionary interest
items.answerZh: 次承租人付租金給原租客
items.trapEn: Do not treat the subtenant as a direct replacement tenant under an assignment.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Sublease」，應立刻聯想：次承租人付租金給原租客。補充說明：Blithe→Earnest。

items.answerEn: Tenant pays fixed rent while the landlord pays most operating expenses
items.answerZh: 租客付固定租金，房東付多數費用
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Gross lease」，應立刻聯想：租客付固定租金，房東付多數費用。

items.answerEn: Tenant pays rent plus specified taxes, insurance, maintenance, or other expenses
items.answerZh: 租客另付稅／保險／維護等
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Net lease」，應立刻聯想：租客另付稅／保險／維護等。

items.answerEn: Base rent plus a percentage of the tenant's gross sales
items.trapEn: Common in retail property.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Percentage lease」，應立刻聯想：底租＋營業額抽成。補充說明：零售常見。

items.answerEn: Rent increases at stated intervals
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Step-up」，應立刻聯想：租金按階段調升。

items.answerEn: Court action used by a landlord to regain possession lawfully
items.trapEn: A landlord may not use self-help such as changing locks or shutting off utilities.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Unlawful detainer」，應立刻聯想：房東合法驅離訴訟。易錯提醒：禁止私自換鎖斷水電。

items.answerEn: Landlord's wrongful acts or omissions make the premises unusable and force the tenant to leave
items.answerZh: 房東違法迫使無法居住
items.trapEn: It is not a lawful eviction method.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Constructive eviction」，應立刻聯想：房東違法迫使無法居住。補充說明：違法。

items.answerEn: Generally one month's rent under current law, subject to statutory exceptions
items.answerZh: 上限常考「最多約一個月租金」取向
items.trapEn: Check the current Civil Code and any stated exception in the question.
items.trapZh: 題庫若寫 one month 依最新法複核
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Security deposit（加州現制常考）」，應立刻聯想：上限常考「最多約一個月租金」取向。補充說明：題庫若寫 one month 依最新法複核。

items.answerEn: Generally provide the itemized statement and remaining deposit within 21 days after move-out
items.answerZh: 常見考點：搬出後約 21 天內明細／退還
items.trapEn: Apply the current California Civil Code.
items.trapZh: 依現行 Civil Code 複核

items.answerZh: 無色無味放射性氣體，經地基裂縫進入
items.trapEn: It results from uranium decay.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Radon」，應立刻聯想：無色無味放射性氣體，經地基裂縫進入。補充說明：鈾衰變。

items.answerEn: Commonly associated with older paint and plumbing; pre-1978 housing triggers federal disclosure
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Lead」，應立刻聯想：舊油漆／水管；Pre-1978。

items.answerEn: Urea-formaldehyde foam insulation
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「UFFI」，應立刻聯想：脲甲醛泡沫絕緣。

items.answerEn: Chlorofluorocarbons formerly used in refrigerants and air-conditioning equipment
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「CFCs」，應立刻聯想：舊冷媒／空調含氯氟碳。

items.answerEn: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning
items.trapEn: The H does not mean home.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「HVAC」，應立刻聯想：Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning。易錯提醒：H≠Home。

items.answerEn: Pipes carrying wastewater away from a dwelling
items.trapEn: Municipal water lines bring potable water in.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Wastewater lines」，應立刻聯想：把水排離住宅的管線。補充說明：City water＝進水。

items.answerEn: Built for an identified buyer to that buyer's specifications
items.answerZh: 買家先確定＋依規格訂製
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Custom home」，應立刻聯想：買家先確定＋依規格訂製。

items.answerEn: Built without a specific buyer in anticipation of a later sale
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Spec」，應立刻聯想：無特定買家先建再賣。

items.answerEn: One of many standardized model homes in a planned development
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Tract home」，應立刻聯想：標準化模型大量開發。

items.answerEn: Industrial real estate

items.answerEn: Warehousing, manufacturing, and logistics uses
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Industrial」，應立刻聯想：倉儲、製造、物流。

items.cueEn: Large employer enters a small town

items.answerZh: 人口↑需求↑供給相對緊→房價↑
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「大型雇主進駐小鎮」，應立刻聯想：人口↑需求↑供給相對緊→房價↑。

items.answerEn: Prices tend to fall, all else equal
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「供給增加」，應立刻聯想：價格傾向下跌。

items.answerEn: A licensee may specialize by property, client, service, or geographic market
items.answerZh: 多數人可用多種方式專精
items.trapEn: A different real estate license is not necessarily required.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Specialization」，應立刻聯想：多數人可用多種方式專精。補充說明：不一定要換照。

items.answerEn: Shares are relatively liquid and trade much like stocks
items.trapEn: Returns may differ from and sometimes trail direct property ownership.
items.trapZh: 相對直接持房報酬可能較低
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「REIT 優點」，應立刻聯想：股份流動性高如股票。補充說明：相對直接持房報酬可能較低。

items.cueEn: Office building commanding the highest rent
items.answerEn: Usually a Class A building
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Office building 最高租金」，應立刻聯想：通常 Class A。

items.answerEn: An appraisal
items.trapEn: It is more authoritative than a CMA or BPO.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「最準估值產品」，應立刻聯想：Appraisal。補充說明：高於 CMA／BPO。

items.answerEn: Professional ethical guidance for REALTORS®
items.answerZh: 引導 REALTOR® 日常倫理
items.trapEn: NAR is not a government licensing enforcement agency.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「NAR Code of Ethics」，應立刻聯想：引導 REALTOR® 日常倫理。易錯提醒：非政府執法機關。

items.answerZh: 特定人可在無獨立 escrow 執照下任託管（有例外資格）

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Escrow holder（加州）」，應立刻聯想：特定人可在無獨立 escrow 執照下任託管（有例外資格）。補充說明：依題選合資格者。

items.answerEn: Completion of the transaction and title transfer

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Closing」，應立刻聯想：結案過戶完成。補充說明：其前合約多為 executory。

items.answerEn: Protection against covered title defects and risks

items.answerEn: Mineral owner may make reasonable use of the surface to extract minerals
items.answerZh: 礦權人可合理進入地表開採（非重大惡意破壞）
items.trapEn: Surface ownership does not automatically defeat valid mineral rights.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Mineral rights 優先」，應立刻聯想：礦權人可合理進入地表開採（非重大惡意破壞）。補充說明：Surface 不當然優先。

items.answerEn: Protects lawful possession from interference by a landlord or superior title claimant
items.answerZh: 不受前權利人騷擾等，非「不能有噪音」
items.trapEn: It is not a promise of silence and does not erase valid mineral rights.
items.trapZh: 不能用來排除合法礦權
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Quiet enjoyment」，應立刻聯想：不受前權利人騷擾等，非「不能有噪音」。易錯提醒：不能用來排除合法礦權。

items.answerEn: A will whose material provisions are in the testator's handwriting
items.answerZh: 須親筆書寫；不能只簽 X
items.trapEn: Merely signing an X is insufficient; ink color is not the issue.
items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Holographic will」，應立刻聯想：須親筆書寫；不能只簽 X。易錯提醒：墨水顏色非重點。

items.answerEn: A cooperative listing database and marketing system

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「MLS」，應立刻聯想：聯賣系統／平台，非法律上的 listing 契約類型。補充說明：Open／Exclusive 才是契約類型。

items.answerEn: A buyer meeting the seller's terms, often supporting procuring cause and commission entitlement

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Ready, willing and able buyer」，應立刻聯想：常構成 procuring cause／賺佣基礎。

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Unit-in-place」，應立刻聯想：成本法估建造成本的方法→屬 Appraising。

items.explainZh: 題幹若出現「Prorations」，應立刻聯想：結案時稅／租金等按日拆分。

quickCards.en: Listing four: Right-to-sell (full commission) / Agency (owner-sale exception) / Open (procuring cause) / Net (excess).
quickCards.zh: Listing 四兄弟：Right-to-sell（全佣）／Agency（自售免）／Open（促成）／Net（超額）

quickCards.en: Four leaseholds: Estate for years / Periodic / At will / At sufferance.
Income ladder: PGI → EGI → NOI; Value = NOI ÷ Cap rate. Annualize monthly NOI first.
quickCards.zh: 收益三階：PGI → EGI → NOI → ÷Cap＝Value（月 NOI 先×12）

quickCards.en: Three approaches: Sales comparison (existing homes) / Cost (new construction) / Income (investment).
quickCards.zh: 估價三法：比較（中古）／成本（新屋）／收益（投資）

quickCards.en: Three disclosures: TDS (condition) / NHD (hazard zones) / Lead (pre-1978).
quickCards.zh: 揭露三表：TDS（屋況）／NHD（災害區）／Lead（1978前）

quickCards.en: As-is does not waive disclosure; generally do not volunteer AIDS/sex-offender information; refuse concealment.
quickCards.zh: As-is ≠ 免揭露；AIDS／性罪犯通常不主動揭；客戶叫隱瞞＝拒絕

quickCards.en: -OR gives; -EE receives. The optionor is normally the seller, not the buyer.
quickCards.zh: -OR 給、-EE 收；Optionor 是賣方不是買方

quickCards.en: When zoning and a deed restriction conflict, obey the stricter rule; racial/religious restrictions are void.
quickCards.zh: Deed 衝突跟最嚴；種族宗教限制＝無效

quickCards.en: Acceptance must be communicated; withdraw a counter before accepting another; specific performance means that unique property.
quickCards.zh: 接受要送達；Counter 先撤再收；Specific performance＝要那棟屋
